text:
marie_sales: Kicking off RFI thread for Valence Health. They want a POC (3-week) with private VPC, SAML SCIM provisioning, and a security pack. Also asked for embeddings throughput 100 qps and streaming latency targets. Need capmatrix + pricing tiers + short SOW.

josh_se: I can own the capability matrix + SAML/SCIM answer. Quick check: do they require on-prem HSM or will CloudHSM suffice?

ryan_sre: CloudHSM should be fine for initial POC. If they require on-site HSM we need lead time ~3 weeks for support package. For 100 QPS embeddings, estimate 6xA10 or 2xA100 with batching + KV caching. Latency: single-embed median ~30-60ms depending on payload.

priya_prod: We'll include an optional quantized model path (int8) to reduce instance needs. Also note we support streaming with chunked responses and resumable sessions.

marie_sales: Legal also asked about data residency and egress rules for PHI workloads. Can SRE confirm audit/log retention options and whether we can restrict egress to their VPC only?

ryan_sre: We can lock egress to customer-managed peering and support strict routing. Audit logs retention configurable (30/90/365 days) as an add-on. PHI: recommend Dedicated or Private for compliance.

josh_se: I'll draft the capmatrix snippet here (will paste into spreadsheet):

```
Requirement                   | Redwood Response                  | Notes
---------------------------- | --------------------------------- | -----------------------------
SAML/SCIM Provisioning       | Supported                         | SAML IdP + SCIM 2.0 provisioning
Private VPC                  | Private deployment (VPC)         | Customer-managed routing
HSM Options                  | CloudHSM, Thales, Entrust        | On-prem support with lead time
Embeddings throughput target | 100 QPS achievable                | 6xA10 or 2xA100, batching, KV cache
Streaming latency target      | 50ms median (token stream)       | Depends on model & seq len
Audit logs & retention       | Configurable                      | 30/90/365 days (paid tiers)
Data residency               | Regional deployments supported    | EU/US/APAC regions available
Attestations                | SOC2, ISO27001, PCI (partial)    | FedRAMP status note available
```

josh_se: I'll upload the draft capmatrix in a bit.

marie_sales: Pricing ask: they want POC price for embeddings + streaming, then production commit. Priya, can you propose tiered pricing and a POC discount? Also include SOW milestones.

priya_prod: Draft pricing plan: POC: 4-week reserved capacity at 40% off list for 1 month, includes 1 eng support hour/day during POC. Production tiers: volume bands for embeddings (<=5M / 5-25M / >25M tokens) with per-embed price drop. Streaming billed per-token with baseline compute surcharge for low-latency SLA. Add-on: 365-day observability retention + compliance pack. I'll attach a one-pager.

gcp-bot: File uploaded by josh_se: valence_capmatrix_draft.xlsx -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1739998888/valence_capmatrix_draft.xlsx

josh_se: Uploaded. I flagged open items: exact SLA for token latency, SCIM attribute mapping (they want groups->roles), and KMS attestation under NDA.

marie_sales: Action items: (1) @josh_se finalize capmatrix + SCIM mapping note, (2) @ryan_sre confirm final perf numbers and HSM lead times, (3) @priya_prod finalize pricing + SOW one-pager. Target: send draft RFI response tomorrow noon.

ryan_sre: HSM lead times: CloudHSM immediate, Thales integration ~2-3 weeks, on-prem HSM install support ~4-5 weeks (procurement dependent). Perf note: I'll run a quick microbenchmark and post numbers before EOD.

josh_se: Noted. I'll add a row: "attestations available under NDA" and include SOC2/ISO refs.

priya_prod: I'll add an example acceptance test: embedding recall >= 0.7 on provided eval set + streaming 95th perc latency < 200ms.

marie_sales: Perfect. If Valence pushes FedRAMP, escalate to GRC. Otherwise we'll send NDA and package.

josh_se: One small ask from their infra: can we provide a sample IAM policy for cross-account peering? I have a template, will attach.

marie_sales: Great. Wrap up: I'll assemble attachments and circulate internal review before sending. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

ryan_sre: Uploaded perf microbenchmark: valence_embedding_bench_v1.txt -> https://redwood.docs/attachments/1739998888/valence_embedding_bench_v1.txt

marie_sales: Closing thread. Will post final sent timestamp when done.
